item.title: A Beginner’s Guide to Understanding Web Analytics
item.description:
A Beginner’s Guide to Understanding Web Analytics

Web analytics is a crucial component of digital success. Whether you’re a website development firm, a digital marketer, or a small business, mastering web analytics can unlock valuable insights into your online presence.

What Is Web Analytics?

Web analytics involves measuring, collecting, and analyzing website data to assess visitor behavior. It helps businesses understand what works, what doesn’t, and how to improve digital strategies.
